about_the_game:
What is the most powerful weapon against an evil boss ruling over a dungeon full of monsters? An ancient sword? A magic ring? No! The most powerful spell of all: Unionization! 

Hoard’s LLC is a cozy, story-driven puzzle game where you play as Barry, a mild-mannered minotaur working deep in the depths of a corporate dungeon. When Barry starts to realize his coworkers are being exploited, he sets out to do something truly radical: help them.

Navigate a maze of departments—like Loot Logistics and Monster Resources—solving clever puzzles to reconnect isolated coworkers. Along the way, you'll uncover endearing stories, roll your eyes at cheesy corporate humor, and bring together a community that needs each other now more than ever.


Help Barry navigate dungeon departments by rotating tiles to create paths.

  • Solve puzzles to get to coworkers

  • Hear their endearing stories

  • Deal with the cheeky corporate humor

  • Unionize!
